stops.note: named a dense black wood sourced from Nubia
Greek traders adapted the Egyptian name for the prized black wood
Romans continued using the Greek-derived term in natural histories
settled into English via Latin, later extended to describe a deep black color
stops.meaning: a hard black wood, or the color black

current_meaning: A dense, black hardwood prized for fine furniture and carvings; also used to describe a deep black color.
